retrieval_policy.default: Treat descriptions and URLs as metadata until content is explicitly staged and verified.
retrieval_policy.future_public_retrieval: Allowed only in a separately authorized job whose scope permits network access and provenance capture.
required_for_each_retrieved_item: Resolve and record the exact source and final location
Confirm access is public or otherwise explicitly authorized
Record applicable license or terms and retrieval provenance
Compute a content hash and classify whether the item is an official unit, supplemental resource, or catalog context
Keep failed, partial, or ambiguous retrievals marked unavailable
never_retrieve_or_expose: Authentication-gated or otherwise restricted content without explicit authorization
Secrets, hidden graders, sealed references, or examiner-only material for a learner
retrieval_policy.failure_policy: Fail closed: do not infer missing content, do not promote a link or description into an available unit, and leave the affected item blocked.
retrieval_policy.expansion_policy: Later jobs may add units only from individually classified, staged, provenance-recorded material; this kickoff does not authorize or imply whole-course expansion.
